text:
Lena K.: Quick thread: we got feedback that the dashboard y-axis units disappear when 'smooth series' is enabled on dense charts. Need proposals for preserving clarity without clutter.

Marcus: Saw this too. Ops thought units switched to percentages. I think hiding them is risky. Maybe show abbreviated units (e.g., 'ms' -> 'ms') with lower emphasis.

Aisha: Accessibility concern: visual de-emphasis alone isn't enough. Screen reader should still read the full unit and any transformation applied (smoothing/clipping). Use an aria-live phrase like: 'Chart updated: smoothing enabled; y-axis unit: milliseconds.'

Priya: Layout idea: collapse full unit label into a single-line pill to the right of the axis when smoothing is on. Hover/tap expands to full text. Keeps axis tight but makes unit discoverable.

Lena K.: Love the pill idea. Two constraints: 1) pill must be reachable by keyboard (tab order); 2) contrast must meet AA for small text or provide clear focus outline.

Marcus: Copy options for the pill tooltip/aria label:
- "Unit: milliseconds (ms)"
- "Unit: ms — view full"
- "ms — press for full unit"

Aisha: Prefer explicit verbs for SR: "View full unit" or "Expanded: unit milliseconds". Also suggest aria-haspopup="true" on the pill and role="button" so assistive tech knows it can expand.

Priya: Quick CSS sketch to keep things minimal:
```css
.axis-unit-pill {
  font-size: 12px;
  opacity: 0.75;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-elev-1);
}
.axis-unit-pill:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); }
```

Marcus: Behavior edge-case: if smoothing also clips outliers, the axis scale might change. We should show a transient banner near the axis: "Scale adjusted (2 outliers hidden)" so viewers don't assume data loss. Banner should be visually subtle and dismissible.

Lena K.: Agree. Proposed banner copy: "Scale adjusted — 2 outliers hidden. Show full range." Short button toggles raw range. Banner must be keyboard-focusable and announced by aria-live="polite".

Aisha: For the live announcements, include the number and unit: "Chart updated: smoothing enabled; 2 outliers hidden; y-axis unit: milliseconds." That gives context. Also, ensure reduced-motion respects user prefs when animating pill expand.

Priya: Interaction flow mock: tab sequence -> chart controls -> axis-unit-pill -> pill expands inline (or popup) showing full unit and a link "Show raw range". If popup, trap focus inside until closed.

Marcus: Tests: 1) visual regression for pill collapsed vs expanded; 2) keyboard nav tests; 3) aria-live content snapshot. I'll add those to the chart component test file.

Lena K.: Final copy options to decide by EOD:
- Pill short: "ms" with tooltip "Unit: milliseconds"; live: "Chart updated: smoothing enabled; y-axis unit milliseconds"
- Pill short: "Unit" with tooltip "milliseconds (ms) — press to expand"; live: "Chart updated: smoothing enabled; 2 outliers hidden"

Aisha: Vote for option 1 (explicit unit visible). Less guessing.

Priya: I'll prototype the pill animation (120ms fade + scale) and include reduced-motion fallback.

Lena K.: Action items: Marcus add tests & hook for outlier_count; Priya push prototype and keyboard flow doc; Aisha add aria-live templates to the a11y checklist; Lena will update copy and file a small design token for pill focus.

Marcus: I'll open a draft PR linking the prototype and tests. ETA tomorrow morning.

aria-bot: Heads up — design sync at 2pm PT today. Please add the PR link when available.
